name: realtime-translate
description: Reliable browser-based realtime transcription and translation

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @realtime-translate/contracts build && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "pnpm --filter @realtime-translate/server dev" "pnpm --filter @realtime-translate/web dev"
scripts.dev:local: pnpm --filter @realtime-translate/contracts build && concurrently -k -n whisper,server,web -c yellow,green,cyan "pnpm whisper:start" "pnpm --filter @realtime-translate/server dev" "pnpm --filter @realtime-translate/web dev"
